scope: Safe, non-mutating public-source seed candidates for Spiral restaurant website agency around Schaumburg / northwest Chicago suburbs.

candidates.name: Barakat Restaurant
candidates.why_sellable: Distinctive Central Asian / European story with public reservation and order intent; official site appears to be a thin Lovable shell.
candidates.visible_website_gap_or_opportunity: Official fetch exposed only title/badge; raw HTML contains Lovable/TODO metadata and no readable menu/reserve/order/location content.
candidates.conversion_path: Reserve table / walk in, plus Toast pickup ordering; site should explain signature dishes and route to reserve/order/directions.
evidence: Official site fetch showed only 'Barakat' plus 'Edit with Lovable'.
Raw HTML includes placeholder TODO title comments and author=Lovable.
Search/OpenTable snippets described plov, manti, lagman, steaks, fresh pasta, and Central Asian/European positioning.
Toast search snippet showed pickup from 1090 Landmeier Road, Elk Grove Village, IL.
risks_unknowns: May be a recently launched/in-progress official site.
Need verify hours, current menu, owner/contact name, preferred reservation/order providers, and photo permissions.
Cuisine labeling varies across public sources.

candidates.name: The Chef Grill
candidates.why_sellable: Authentic halal Turkish/Mediterranean positioning with open kitchen, charcoal kebabs, manti, pide, stews, soups, breakfast/lunch, and order-platform demand.
candidates.visible_website_gap_or_opportunity: Homepage has identity, but official menu extraction only exposed category headings and typos like Appettetiers/Cheff.
candidates.conversion_path: Pickup/delivery through order.online/Grubhub/Uber Eats, plus dine-in directions/call; catering/group meals if verified.
evidence: Official homepage fetch described halal meats, Turkish/Mediterranean dishes, open kitchen, manti, brick-oven pide, charcoal-grilled kebabs.
Official menu fetch exposed only categories such as Breakfast, Soups, SALADS, Cold Appettetiers, Entrees And Cheff Special, BRICK OVENS, Kebabs.
Search/order listings show 812 E Higgins Rd, Elk Grove Village.
risks_unknowns: Need full current menu/prices and hours.
Need direct phone/contact and owner name.
Need verify catering truth and whether menu content is hidden behind scripts.

candidates.name: Big Ange's Eatery
candidates.why_sellable: Family-owned BBQ/sandwich concept with in-house smoked meats, homemade sides, outdoor deck, and catering.
candidates.visible_website_gap_or_opportunity: Current site has real content but duplicated footer/nav blocks, repeated catering PDFs, and awkward copy; strong chance to improve catering/order clarity.
candidates.conversion_path: Order carryout/delivery through Grubhub/order link; secondary catering inquiry/PDF, call, directions, outdoor-deck dine-in.
evidence: Official site lists address, hours, BBQ/sandwich menu, catering PDFs, and Grubhub order link.
Chamber listing says family-owned/operated, established June 2016, with brisket, tri-tip, pastrami, ribs, homemade sides, outdoor deck, catering.
risks_unknowns: Existing web vendor/copyright means pitch should be a conversion upgrade, not broken-site rescue.
Need verify current catering PDF/prices and direct contact.

candidates.name: Palatine Inn Restaurant
candidates.why_sellable: Family-owned 20+ year Greek/American breakfast-lunch-dinner restaurant with broad menu, daily specials, homemade soups, and alcohol.
candidates.visible_website_gap_or_opportunity: Older WordPress-heavy site; menu extraction showed all-caps descriptions and social embed/share noise; DoorDash badge does more conversion work than the page hierarchy.
candidates.conversion_path: DoorDash/order, call, directions, and breakfast/lunch/dinner menu browsing; daily specials/social proof as secondary.
evidence: Official site lists 95 W Northwest Hwy, Palatine, IL and DoorDash link.
OPA Chicago fetch says family-owned, breakfast/lunch/dinner seven days, over 20 years, homemade soups, daily specials, hours, phone.
risks_unknowns: Need verify current menu/prices, online ordering preference, owner/contact, and group-order/catering options.

candidates.name: Sweet Orange Pancake House & Cafe
candidates.why_sellable: Family-owned 20+ year Schaumburg brunch spot with deep breakfast/cafe menu and direct order link.
candidates.visible_website_gap_or_opportunity: Functional but generic/duplicative homepage; /order-online/ returns 404 while real order link exists in nav/HTML; menu needs stronger mobile hierarchy.
candidates.conversion_path: Order.store pickup/delivery, call, directions, menu browsing, and Instagram/social proof.
evidence: Official homepage fetch captured address, phone, hours, delivery section, and family-owned 20+ years positioning.
Official menu fetch captured broad categories and sample items/prices.
Site HTML exposed order.store, Instagram, and Facebook URLs; /order-online/ fetch returned a 404 page.
risks_unknowns: Existing site is functional and menu-rich; pitch is polish/conversion.
Need verify latest menu/prices, owner/contact, and whether 404 order path affects users.
